registry_notes: Records whose implementation.state is registered describe the actual MCP surface in corel_operator/server.py.
Records whose implementation.state is planned are catalog entries only and are not exposed by the MCP server.
All current tools remain implemented_unverified until a reproducible X7 live-test report is recorded.
Since bridge 0.6.0 every tool returns tool-schema v1: a stable envelope whose data field contains the operation-specific result.
ID-001: eleven registered selector tools accept signed session object_reference values. StaticID-derived object_id strings remain inspection-only; no persistent cross-session identity is promised.

tools.name: corel_status
tools.description: Report CorelDRAW connection, version, active document, and protected target-document state without editing a document.
known_limitations: The explicit X7 connection strategy has fake-COM coverage but still needs a recorded live MCP call.
The generic ProgID remains a fallback and is accepted only after major-version validation.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new CorelDRAW document, set its first page size in inches, and bind it as the protected target document.
known_limitations: Page dimensions/unit/reference point are read back, but still require a recorded X7 live test.
Does not assign a persistent document session ID.

tools.name: use_active_document
tools.description: Explicitly bind the currently active CorelDRAW document as the mutation target after confirmation.

confirm_existing_document.description: Must be true after the user explicitly authorizes editing the active document.

known_limitations: No automatic checkpoint copy or undo transaction is created.
Identity is an in-memory COM proxy and is lost on server restart.

tools.name: add_text
tools.description: Create editable artistic text on the active layer of the protected target document.
known_limitations: Content/font/size/bold and bounds are read back, but insertion-point semantics still need a live X7 test.
Explicit ANSI charset may not handle multilingual text correctly.

tools.name: draw_rectangle
tools.description: Create a rectangle using a lower-corner position and dimensions in inches.
known_limitations: Actual bounds are read back, but still require a recorded X7 live test.

tools.name: draw_ellipse
tools.description: Create an ellipse from a requested lower-left bounding position and dimensions in inches.
known_limitations: Center/radius conversion is checked by fake-COM readback but still needs a recorded X7 live test.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List top-level shapes on the target document's active page with basic identity, type, bounds, text, and outline data.
known_limitations: Shape indexes are unstable.
Nested group traversal is undefined.
Outline width is labeled as points without verified unit semantics.
Does not return fill colors, stable IDs, page/layer identity, or object rotation.

tools.name: set_fill_color
tools.description: Apply a uniform RGB fill to exactly one selected object in the target document.
known_limitations: Native fill/color values are read back without model conversion, but still need a recorded X7 live test.
RGB only for mutation; no CMYK/spot-color setter semantics yet.

tools.name: import_artwork
tools.description: Import an allowlisted local raster or vector file onto the active layer and name identified imported objects.
known_limitations: Allowed extension does not prove the installed X7 filter can import every listed format.
UNC/device-path policy is not explicit.
Imported identity now includes StaticID/layer/page where available, but fallback collection ordering still needs a live test.
Imported bounds and embedded/link status are not reported.

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Save the bound target document as a new CDR file using explicit X7 save options and refuse overwrite.
known_limitations: Creates missing parent directories without a separate allowlist.
Hard-coded enum values are now type-library-confirmed but not centralized in code.
No checkpoint/backup semantics for existing documents.

tools.name: export_pdf
tools.description: Publish the bound target document to a new PDF path without overwriting an existing file.
known_limitations: Verifies that PublishToPDF creates a nonempty file, but does not parse the PDF.
Inherits CorelDRAW PDF settings.
Does not inspect page dimensions, bleed, fonts, color profile, or print readiness.

tools.name: list_open_documents
tools.description: List open documents with safe identity and dirty/path state without changing the active document.
known_limitations: Document session IDs are process-local and are not preserved after an MCP server restart.
COM IUnknown identity is used when available; fake/non-COM objects use Python object identity.

tools.name: get_document_info
tools.description: Return identity, path, dirty state, units, page count, and active-page information for the bound target document.
known_limitations: Document session identity is stable only for the lifetime of the bridge process.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List every page in the target document with index, name, orientation, dimensions, and active state.
known_limitations: Orientation is returned as the native X7 code until the installed enum evidence is expanded.
Page dimensions and collection behavior still require a live multi-page X7 test.

tools.name: get_page_bounds
tools.description: Return explicit lower-left, upper-right, center, width, and height values for one page in inches.
known_limitations: Bounds use an explicit page-local bottom-left coordinate space derived from page size.
Drawing-origin and facing-page semantics require live X7 tests.

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: List page and master layers with visibility, editability, printability, active state, and object counts.
known_limitations: Uses Page.AllLayers when available and falls back to Page.Layers.
Master and special-layer semantics require a live multi-page X7 test.

tools.name: get_object_info
tools.description: Inspect one unambiguously selected object's identity, page/layer, type, bounds, transform, text, fill, and outline.
known_limitations: object_reference is issued by one bridge/document session and requires matching page/layer/group identity, native shape identity, StaticID, name and type; no stale fallback.

tools.name: get_object_bounds
tools.description: Read finite object bounds in inches using the document ruler and bottom-left reference; restore inspection context.
known_limitations: Coordinates retain the current document ruler origin; page-local, outline-inclusive, and facing-page semantics are not claimed.
Returned IDs are inspection-only and bridge-local; stale-reference detection is a separate ticket.

References require readable StaticID and untruncated names; inspect again after rename, regroup, document reopening or bridge restart. X7 live behavior is deferred.

tools.name: find_objects
tools.description: Read-only, bounded literal search on the bound document with explicit page/layer scope and deterministic nested-group paths. Duplicate names are retained.
known_limitations: Results and StaticID-derived IDs are inspection data only; editing accepts the existing unique-name or explicit active-page index selectors.
Document session IDs are bridge-local and are not persistent across restart or guaranteed after save/reopen.
Collection order and group paths describe this inspection and may change after edits; duplicate names are never silently collapsed.
Master-layer objects can appear once per applicable page with the same StaticID and distinct page locations.
Only cdrGroupShape children are traversed; PowerClip, symbols, and other container types are outside this scope.
max_scan counts page, layer, and shape visits; inspect truncated and incomplete_reasons before treating absence or result counts as complete.
All-page nested search and StaticID behavior still require a guarded disposable X7 live test.
Search emits signed session references when complete native identity metadata is available; object_id remains inspection-only. Complete scope uniqueness is checked on resolution.

tools.name: get_text_properties
tools.description: Read bounded text content and whole-story aggregate font, size, style and alignment codes; report unavailable or indeterminate properties.
known_limitations: Whole-story aggregates do not describe character runs or prove uniform formatting.
Text subtype, spacing, font availability and overflow inspection are deferred.

tools.name: get_fill
tools.description: Read fill type and native uniform color without color-model conversion; bound string summaries and identify missing properties.
known_limitations: Complex fill internals and unsupported color-model channels are outside type_and_uniform_color scope.

tools.name: get_outline
tools.description: Return the actual outline type, color, width, and style for one object with explicit units.
known_limitations: Outline.Width unit semantics must be established before the schema can promise points.

tools.name: plan_print_job
tools.description: Inspect one raster artwork file and produce deterministic best-fit imposition, production quantities, fit/crop geometry, effective DPI, bleed, safe area, waste, and per-copy rotation without opening CorelDRAW.
known_limitations: Handles one bounded raster artwork file; it reports multi-sheet quantities but the execution workflow prepares one imposed sheet document at a time.
Safe-area geometry is calculated, but artwork content is not semantically inspected.
The report never claims print-ready status because output profiles, marks, fonts, and exported PDF properties are not checked.

tools.name: prepare_print_job
tools.description: Create a new exact-size CorelDRAW sheet, import validated raster artwork, apply contain/cover/stretch geometry, and place deterministic named N-up copies with planned per-copy rotation after blocking preflight passes.
known_limitations: Cover mode creates a temporary lossless TIFF center-crop derivative before import; X7 import and final color behavior still require a disposable live test.
Creates one new document and rejects copy counts that exceed one-sheet capacity.
Does not create print marks, cut paths, spot colors, or controlled PDF output.

tools.name: calculate_sheet_layout
tools.description: Calculate deterministic upright, rotated, mixed-strip, and sheet-orientation N-up candidates with allowances, waste, and production quantities without touching CorelDRAW.
known_limitations: Uses guillotine-friendly rectangular grids and complete mixed strips rather than arbitrary Tetris-style nesting.
Bleed must be included in the supplied item dimensions; mark clearance and printer/gripper allowances are geometric reservations only.
Placement coordinates are capped at 2000 while reported capacity remains exact.

tools.name: plan_chest_number_batch
tools.description: Preview and validate a chest-number sequence; optionally calculate its complete sheet layout without editing CorelDRAW.
known_limitations: A sequence is capped at 1000 values; all four item/sheet dimensions are required for layout; this tool does not validate font sizing or create artwork.

tools.name: create_chest_number_batch
tools.description: Generate a validated sequence of editable chest-number designs with deterministic formatting and placement.
known_limitations: Depends on verified text sizing, font availability, alignment, duplication, and sheet-layout capabilities.

tools.name: arrange_n_up_print_sheet
tools.description: Apply a previously validated N-up placement plan to named objects or generated batch items.
known_limitations: Depends on stable object identity and a tested layout calculator.

tools.name: validate_design_plan
tools.description: Validate a multi-element design plan against schema and domain rules without modifying CorelDRAW.
known_limitations: Pure JSON schema and geometric validation only; local artwork files are checked immediately before execution.

tools.name: preview_design_plan
tools.description: Preview layout statistics, palette, typography, and bounding box of a design plan without modifying CorelDRAW.
known_limitations: Estimates bounds and palette without live rendering.

tools.name: execute_design_plan
tools.description: Execute a structured multi-element design plan transactionally with atomic rollback on failure.
known_limitations: Rollback relies on CorelDRAW command-group Undo plus post-Undo object-state verification.
Manual editability review of the dated disposable CDR artifact is still pending.

Ungroup all nested groups recursively by shape index

tools.name: classify_imposition_job
tools.description: Route obvious rectangular jobs without cutter questions and request missing production facts only for non-rectangular contour work.
known_limitations: Auto routing depends on an explicit contour signal or repeat-unit inspection.

tools.name: plan_contour_nesting
tools.description: Plan deterministic, collision-checked complete rows from a closed cut contour, including safe 0/180-degree paired-row interlocking.
known_limitations: Optimizes complete aligned rows at 0 and 180 degrees; it does not perform unrestricted free-form nesting or horizontal row staggering.

tools.name: inspect_repeat_unit
tools.description: Inspect one grouped vector repeat and named closed dieline, flatten curves through CorelDRAW, reject combined sources, and return conditional workflow questions.
known_limitations: Requires one top-level group and one uniquely named closed single-subpath dieline.

tools.name: prepare_contour_nesting
tools.description: Copy one pristine vector repeat to a new output page, create independently named groups, apply planned 0/180 rotations, and verify contour clearance without moving or renaming the source.
known_limitations: Executes one new output page per call. X7 cross-page transfer uses Shape.Copy plus Layer.Paste because CopyToLayer failed live; this replaces current system clipboard contents and is disclosed in the result.

tools.name: prepare_imposition_job
tools.description: Preferred plan/approval/execute orchestrator for selected vector repeats. It routes rectangular and contour jobs, asks only geometry-relevant production questions, fingerprints the approved plan, and preserves the source on a separate output page.
known_limitations: Executes only quantities that fit one output page, keeps rectangular vector jobs upright, replaces current system clipboard contents during X7 cross-page transfer, and does not yet add production marks or controlled export settings.
